<script type="module" id="hl-figure">
const {
  Cam, clamp, extremes, facing, fit, lerp, open, poly, proj, prism, put, rings, ringAt, rrect, seg,
  solid, spring, stepS, tdone, tset, tval, tween, disposer, mk, place, pointer, register,
} = HL;

const T = 3, B = 1.4, LIFT = 9, GMIN = 4, STEP = 45, REST = 0.72;
const NAMES = ["frame", "layout", "cards", "popover"];

// Each layer: its plates, back to front, as [x0, y0, x1, y1, r] with the marks the part really has on its top face.
const LAYERS = [
  [{ f: [0, 0, 128, 88, 7], lines: [[5, 12, 123, 12]], dots: [[8, 6], [14, 6], [20, 6]] }],
  [
    { f: [6, 18, 34, 82, 3], lines: [[11, 26, 28, 26], [11, 33, 24, 33], [11, 40, 26, 40]] },
    { f: [40, 18, 122, 82, 3], lines: [[45, 24, 70, 24]] },
  ],
  [
    { f: [46, 30, 78, 52, 2.5], lines: [[51, 36, 68, 36]] },
    { f: [84, 30, 116, 52, 2.5], lines: [[89, 36, 106, 36]] },
    { f: [46, 58, 116, 77, 2.5], lines: [[51, 64, 100, 64], [51, 70, 84, 70]] },
  ],
  [{ f: [58, 34, 106, 66, 4], lines: [[64, 41, 96, 41], [64, 47, 86, 47]], pill: [84, 56, 100, 61, 2.5] }],
];

function mount({ stage, svg, read }, value) {
  const bag = disposer();
  let gmax = value;

  // Centred on the corners the rest pose really has, so the thumbnail sits in the middle of its
  // frame; the scale leaves room above for the tallest pose the slider allows, a layer lifted.
  const C = Cam(45, 0.5, 1.5);
  const restPts = [];
  LAYERS.forEach((plates, i) => plates.forEach(({ f: [x0, y0, x1, y1] }) => {
    for (const z of [i * value * REST, i * value * REST + T]) restPts.push([x0, y0, z], [x1, y0, z], [x0, y1, z], [x1, y1, z]);
  }));
  fit(C, restPts, 200, 162);
  const P = proj(C), front = facing(C);

  const g = mk("g", {}, svg);
  // construction guides: drops from the popover's sides to the frame, painted behind every plate
  const guides = mk("path", { class: "dash nf" }, g);

  const layers = LAYERS.map((plates, i) => {
    const lg = mk("g", {}, g);
    const parts = plates.map((pl) => {
      const [x0, y0, x1, y1, r] = pl.f;
      const [ring, inner] = rings(x0, y0, x1, y1, r, B);
      const s = solid(lg);
      const marks = mk("path", { class: "nf lo" }, lg);
      const dots = (pl.dots || []).map(() => mk("circle", { r: 1.25, class: "dot off" }, lg));
      const pill = pl.pill ? mk("path", { class: "nf" }, lg) : null;
      return { pl, ring, inner, s, marks, dots, pill };
    });
    return { parts, lift: tween(0), last: NaN };
  });

  const gap = spring(gmax * REST);
  const pop = layers[3].parts[0];

  function drawLayer(L, z) {
    if (z === L.last) return;
    L.last = z;
    const z1 = z + T;
    for (const pt of L.parts) {
      put(pt.s, prism(P, front, pt.ring, pt.inner, z, z1));
      pt.marks.setAttribute("d", (pt.pl.lines || []).map(([a, b, c, d]) => seg(P(a, b, z1), P(c, d, z1))).join(""));
      (pt.pl.dots || []).forEach(([x, y], k) => place(pt.dots[k], P(x, y, z1)));
      if (pt.pill) { const [a, b, c, d, r] = pt.pl.pill; pt.pill.setAttribute("d", poly(ringAt(P, rrect(a, b, c, d, r, 4), z1))); }
    }
  }

  function drawGuides(zTop) {
    const [l, r] = extremes(P, pop.ring);
    guides.setAttribute("d", [l, r].map((q) => seg(P(q.u, q.v, 0), P(q.u, q.v, zTop))).join(""));
  }

  const loop = register(stage, (dt, now) => {
    const moving = stepS(gap, dt);
    let anim = false;
    layers.forEach((L, i) => {
      drawLayer(L, i * gap.x + tval(L.lift, now));
      if (!tdone(L.lift, now)) anim = true;
    });
    drawGuides(3 * gap.x + tval(layers[3].lift, now));
    return moving || anim;
  });
  bag.add(loop.unregister);

  // Layer picking: the screen height of each layer's centre in the REST pose. It moves only with the slider.
  let bands = [];
  const restBands = () => { bands = layers.map((_, i) => P(64, 44, i * gmax * REST + T)[1]); };
  restBands();
  const pick = (y) => {
    let best = 0;
    bands.forEach((b, i) => { if (Math.abs(y - b) < Math.abs(y - bands[best])) best = i; });
    return best;
  };

  let act = -1, over = false;
  function setActive(a) {
    if (a === act) return;
    const now = performance.now(), from = a >= 0 ? a : act;
    act = a;
    layers.forEach((L, i) => {
      tset(L.lift, i === a ? LIFT : 0, now, Math.abs(i - from) * STEP);
      // the rest mark is the popover; a choice takes the bright stroke from it
      const lit = a < 0 ? i === 3 : i === a;
      L.parts.forEach((pt) => pt.s.sil.classList.toggle("hi", lit));
    });
    read.textContent = a < 0 ? "rest" : NAMES[a];
    loop.wake();
  }
  pop.s.sil.classList.add("hi");
  read.textContent = "rest";

  bag.add(pointer(stage, {
    move: ([x, y]) => {
      over = true;
      gap.t = lerp(GMIN, gmax, clamp((x - 70) / 260, 0, 1));
      setActive(pick(y));
      loop.wake();
    },
    leave: () => { over = false; gap.t = gmax * REST; setActive(-1); loop.wake(); },
  }));
  bag.add(() => svg.replaceChildren());

  return {
    set: (v) => {
      gmax = v;
      restBands();
      if (!over) gap.t = gmax * REST;
      loop.wake();
    },
    destroy: bag.dispose,
  };
}

hairline({
  name: "layers",
  means: "An app window taken apart into four layers: moving across opens the gap, moving down picks a layer.",
  rules: [1, 5, 6, 8],
  range: [18, 28, 36],
  mount,
});
</script>
